summary: Range-bound session: the Nifty hovers just below flat while midcaps and small caps hold gains of about 0.6–0.7%, so the broad market is doing better than the headline index.

detail.leaders: Nifty IT (+2%, mid-tier IT led by Coforge, OFSS), PSU banks; MidCap +0.58%, SmallCap +0.74%
detail.laggards: Metals, pharma, healthcare; BSE after its Nifty entry
detail.tone: Little changed from 10:30: at 11:00 the Sensex was up 158.70 (+0.22%) at 72,687.77 and the Nifty down 19 (−0.08%) at 22,697.20. The Sensex's gain from 10:30 hasn't carried through to the Nifty.

top.title: Nifty breaks its 200-day average on a weekly basis
top.line: The first such breach in six years; the seven-week slide has wiped out about $250 bn
more: The index is at its lowest close since early April

Oil, foreign outflows and a lack of AI-linked plays are cited
